title: KimetsuCraft - KC
description: Kimetsu No Yaiba Mod! By Nabkami
body:
![KimetsuCraft](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1501048/description_bedada0f-265d-4439-a862-60f1064dcbf9.png) ![Available for Forge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/forge_64h.png) [![Support me on Ko-fi](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_64h.png)](https://ko-fi.com/nabkami) [![Chat with us on Discord](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/social/discord-plural_64h.png)](https://discord.gg/JYAVPUTPDn) [![Read the Wiki](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/documentation/website_64h.png)](https://kimetsucraft.pages.dev/) *** ## Features The mod adds a variety of new features: * **Breathing Styles:** Water and Flame, 8 forms each, with custom animations and VFX. More styles on the way. * **Nichirin Swords:** forged from Nichirin Ore and shaped by six stats that change how they feel in combat. * **NPCs and demons:** Giyu and Rengoku fight on their own, chain forms and react to the player. Demons come in three tiers, each with hidden tricks. * **Wisteria biomes:** Wisteria Forest and Wisteria Oasis generate in the Overworld, home to three Wisteria wood variants and the Nichirin Forge. * **In-game configuration:** tweak every balance value, technique parameter and NPC profile from a GUI. No config files, no restarts. * **Rank ladder:** 11 tiers from Mizunoto to Hashira, earned through real fights. ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1501048/description_645e399b-497b-487d-8468-7dcd3bc61ea5.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_f8c891c2-6010-4b28-9608-d070d19c539c.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_a0bb8541-9624-4a50-8650-916c8a2903a4.png) ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1501048/description_96c29b94-d7c2-42b0-b5cb-7d3cb2b1d4c3.png) *** ## Requirements / Dependances **Recommended versions:** GeckoLib 4.8.3 · Player Animator 1.0.2 · BendyLib · 4.0.0 AAA Particles 1.4.15 (Effekseer VFX) *** ## FAQ **Does it work on servers?** Yes, networking is built for multiplayer from the ground up. **What about shaders?** Embeddium + Oculus is the recommended setup. OptiFine may have glitches with GeckoLib models depending on the version. **Can I use it in a modpack?** Yes. Everything is configurable and built to coexist with other mods. *** ## Permissions | |
